material.title: Material of the Lateral Load-Resisting System
material.name: material

height_ground_floor.title: height of ground floor above grade
height_ground_floor.name: height_ground_floor

CHV.title: Change in vertical structure (includes large overhangs)
CHV.name: CHV

CLBLH.title: Fired clay hollow blocks or tiles
CLBLH.name: CLBLH

DBD.title: Equipped with base isolation and/or energy dissipation devices
DBD.name: DBD

DCW.title: Columns-Wall density
DCW.desc: Float specifying the density or ratio between the area of columns and/or walls and the area of the building plan. (DCW <= 1)
DCW.name: DCW

FN.title: No elevated or suspended floor material (single-storey building)
FN.name: FN

FWCP.title: Floor-wall diaphragm connection present (the role of the connection is to restrain wall out-of-plane forces and to transfer in-plane forces to wall)
FWCP.name: FWCP

GFH.title: Ground floor plan partially open (i.e. with at least 50% of walls).
GFH.name: GFH

GFO.title: Ground floor plan fully open (no walls)
GFO.name: GFO

H.title: Number of storeys above ground
H.desc:
H:n, exact number of storeys above ground.
H:a-b, range of storeys above ground.
H:<n, n upper limit of number of storeys above ground (with n excluded).
H:>n, n lower limit of number of storeys above ground (with n excluded).
H.name: H

HAPP.title: Approximate number of storeys above ground
HAPP.name: HAPP

HB.title: Number of storeys below ground
HB.desc:
Number of storeys below ground (same as number of basements).
HB:n, exact number of storeys below ground.
HB:a-b, range of storeys below ground.
HB:<n, n upper limit of number of storeys below ground (witH n excluded).
HB:>n, n lower limit of number of storeys below ground (witH n excluded).
HB.name: HB

HBAPP.title: Approximate number of storeys below ground
HBAPP.name: HBAPP

HBS.title: Basement presence. Unknown number of storeys below ground
HBS.name: HBS

HD.title: Slope of the ground
HD.desc:
Slope of the ground (n=float in degrees).
HD:n
HD.name: HD

HF.title: Height of ground floor level above grade
HF.desc:
HF:n, exact height of ground floor above grade.
HF:a-b, range of height of ground floor above grade.
HF:<n, n upper limit of the height of ground floor above grade. (with n excluded).
HF:>n, n lower limit of the height of ground floor above grade. (with n excluded).
HF.name: HF

HFAPP.title: Approximate height of ground floor level above grade
HFAPP.name: HFAPP

HHI.title: Inter-storey height (average)
HHI.desc: Total height of the structure, measured from the ground floor.
HHI.name: HHI

HHT.title: Total height of the structure, measured from the ground floor.
HHT.desc:
Total height of the structure, measured from the ground floor. Float specifying the height of the structures in meters. (HHT>= 1)
HHT:n
HHT.name: HHT

LDD.name: LDD

LFC.title: Lateral load coefficient for earthquakes
LFC.desc: LFC:n, n is the lateral force coefficient in percentage (%)
LFC.name: LFC

LFLSINF.title: Infilled flat slab/plate or infilled waffle slab
LFLSINF.name: LFLSINF

LHV.title:
LHV(sys_a;sys_b), differnet LLRS in height 
(a=primary system, and b=secondary system)
LHV.name: LHV

MDD.name: MDD

MDV.title:
MDV(sys_a;sys_b[;...]), different materials in height
(a=primary system; b=secondary system [;...])
MDV.name: MDV

NSN.title: Non structural components requirements, non presence
NSN.name: NSN

PGAR.title: Design Peak Ground Acceleration on rock conditions
PGAR.desc:
Units as a fraction of the gravity force
PGAR:n, exact PGAR value.
PGAR:a-b, range of PGAR value
PGAR:<n, n upper limit of PGAR (with PGAR n excluded).
PGAR:>n, n lower limit of PGAR (with PGAR n excluded).
PGAR.name: PGAR

PGAS.title: Design Peak Ground Acceleration on soil conditions
PGAS.desc:
Units as a fraction of the gravity force
PGAS:n, exact PGAS value.
PGAS:a-b, range of PGAS value
PGAS:<n, n upper limit of PGAS (with PGAS n excluded).
PGAS:>n, n lower limit of PGAS (with PGAS n excluded).
PGAS.name: PGAS

PLFSQO.title: Square, with an interior opening (e.g. a "donut")
PLFSQO.name: PLFSQO

RTDP.title: Roof tie-down present (a connection that provides vertical attachment of roof to wall in order to restrain roof from upward displacement, lift-off due to wind)
RTDP.name: RTDP

RWCP.title: Roof-wall diaphragm connection present (the connection  transfers in-plane forces from floor to wall and restrains wall outward displacements)
RWCP.name: RWCP

WOL.title: Large openings (i.e. more than 50% of the wall surface area is occupied by windows and/or doors)
WOL.name: WOL

WOM.title: Moderate openings (i.e. from 20% to 50% of the wall surface area is occupied by windows and/or doors)
WOM.name: WOM

WOS.title: Small openings (i.e. less than 20% of the wall surface area is occupied by windows and/or doors)
WOS.name: WOS

Y.title: Year of construction or retrofit
Y.desc:
Y:n, exact year of construction or retrofit.
Y:a-b, range of years of construction or retrofit.
Y:<n, n upper limit of year of construction or retrofit (with n excluded).
Y:>n, n lower limit of year of construction or retrofit (with n excluded).
Y.name: Y

YAPP.title: Approximate year of construction or retrofit
YAPP.name: YAPP

_ARG.desc: Virtual atom dependency to prevent arguments-only atoms to be visualized as unconstrained atoms
_ARG.name: _ARG

Precast concrete roof without reinforced concrete topping

Precast concrete floor without reinforced concrete topping

Metal or steel beams supporting precast concrete slabs

Wooden beams or trusses and joists supporting heavy flooring
